ALL THAT CERTAIN tract or parcel of land and premises situate in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden, State of New Jersey, bounded and described as follows:

Beginning at a point in the Northwesterly line of Lot 10, Block 76, where intersected by the Southerly line of Lot 12.09, Block 76, said point being North 32 degrees 22 minutes 35 seconds West, 101.35 feet from the intersection of said Northeasterly line of Lot 10 with the Southerly line of Lot 12.13, Block 76 and running; thence

(1) Along said Northeasterly line of Lot 10, Block 76, North 32 degrees 22 minutes 35 seconds West, 19.87 feet to a point in the division line of Lots 12.08 and 12.09 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(2) Along the said division line, North 60 degrees 54 minutes 43 seconds East, 30.33 feet to a point in same; thence

(3) Still along said division line, North 61 degrees 11 minutes 33 seconds East, 57.39 feet to a point in the Southwesterly line of Lot 12.03; thence

(4) Along said Southwesterly line of Lot 12.03 and along the Southwesterly line of 12.04, South 28 degrees 36 minutes 51 seconds East, 19.98 feet to a point in the division line of Lots 12.09 and 12.10 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(5) Along said division line, South 61 degrees 11 minutes 33 seconds West, 86.41 feet to the point and place of beginning.
expected_legal_description: Beginning at a point in the Northwesterly line of Lot 10, Block 76, where intersected by the Southerly line of Lot 12.09, Block 76; thence (1) through (5) to the point and place of beginning.

critical_assertions.note: Resale of Lot 12.09 from Mussoline to Stuessy. Same legal description as deed 7516-1812. POB description says 'Northwesterly line' but call (1) says 'Northeasterly line' - likely OCR inconsistency.

common_failure_modes: OCR shows 'Northwesterly line of Lot 10' in POB but 'Northeasterly line of Lot 10' in call (1) - inconsistent
Call (4) references 'Southwesterly line of 12.04' missing 'Lot' prefix
notes: Resale of Lot 12.09 just one month after original purchase. Mussoline bought for $441,390 (deed 7516-1812) and sold to Stuessy for $479,000. Identical legal description to the original deed.
